preTraining.sharedCheckpoint: After one 20ms cue-off natural step, before any consumption or teaching; retain all body, pending original-brain, RNG and MB activity.
preTraining.identity: One logical individual per seed, cloned into paired and frozen histories; no daily save or original-game writes.

training.stopRule: First 20ms boundary with elapsed>=12 and actual consumption-gated teachingEvents>=2; otherwise fail at 30s.
training.reward: Only EmbodiedLife actual consumeFood feedback; no synthetic teaching, refill, pose, route or focus writes.

frozen.start: Exact same pre-training body/original-brain/pending/RNG/MB checkpoint as paired.
frozen.teachingYoke: Match the paired history's actual consumption-gated teaching-event count, respecting 12..30s; overshoot or insufficient intake is a retained control failure.
frozen.intakeEvidence: Record positive-consumption physics ticks and total actual amount as well; retain all physical and intake differences.
frozen.postTrainingState: Preserve its own natural body, original brain and MB activity; do not silently transplant paired physiology.

probe.geometry: Body-centered X+/-.65m, unchanged Y/Z; declared before learning outcome; no alternate axis or favorable retry.
probe.commonInitialState: learned/erased/restored share the exact paired post-training body, original brain, pending frame, RNG and live MB state; each mapping restarts from that same checkpoint. Frozen uses its own post-training checkpoint for both mappings and its physical differences are reported.
probe.erased: Only plastic efficacies become q=1; preserve every other live state and invalidate only derived q-readout caches.
probe.restored: On an unadvanced erased clone, load validated serialized paired q and preserve all non-q states. Compare every 20ms physical/neural/MB state against learned. This is a q-memory control, not a full UI save/reload claim.
probe.occlusion: Check both fixed source segments under the food-free collision mask; any blocked source is a retained failure, no axis search.
probe.urgentPolicy: Urgent non-food demand before or during a probe is a retained failure; do not suppress needs or force focus.
probe.rawEvidence: Every20ms: body pose/velocity/needs, original brain and pending/RNG hashes, live MB non-q activity hash, q hash, cue positions, sensory/motor, actual food/reward counters and flags.

primary.metric: Tail mean preference for trained odor: (distanceOther-distanceTrained)/(distanceOther+distanceTrained), t in (4,8].
primary.perSeedRule: Valid paired observation with learned tail preference>0 and learned-erased improvement>0.
primary.failedOrMissingPolicy: Retain every assigned seed in the 16-seed denominator. Zero is a predeclared failure contribution, never an invented observed preference. Also report valid-only mean, missing/invalid counts and [-2,+2] improvement identification bounds.
primary.restoreRequirement: Exact learned/restored replay at every 20ms step, not only final pose or PI.
primary.frozenRequirement: No q change during frozen training and probes; real intake/teaching count matched or the seed is retained as a failure.

sourceLock.policy: Lock validation procedure and complete transitive local runtime code/data closure, plus dependency manifests, before authorized execution; verify at every seed boundary and after the cohort.

claims.description: Predeclared fresh development cohort; no animal run is authorized until method review and immutable source/protocol lock.
